newsitem.title: USA: ARCHER DANIELS CUTS PILGRIM'S PRIDE STAKE.
newsitem.headline: ARCHER DANIELS CUTS PILGRIM'S PRIDE STAKE.

text.p: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. said Wednesday it has reduced its stake in Pilgrim's Pride Corp to 3.94 percent or 1,086,382 shares, from 6.38 percent or 1,761,382 shares.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the Decatur, Ill, food conglomerate said it sold 675,000 shares of the Pittsburg, Texas, chicken producer on Aug. 13 at $11.625 each.
